title: Vulniverse OSV 1.9.2 authoring schema
description: A schema for describing a vulnerability in an open source package. See also https://ossf.github.io/osv-schema/

id.title: Currently supported home database identifier prefixes
id.description: These home databases are also documented at https://ossf.github.io/osv-schema/#id-modified-fields

ecosystem.title: Currently supported ecosystems
ecosystem.description: These ecosystems are also documented at https://ossf.github.io/osv-schema/#affectedpackage-field
ecosystem.pattern: ^(AlmaLinux|Alpaquita|Alpine|Android|Azure Linux|BellSoft Hardened Containers|Bioconductor|Bitnami|Chainguard|CleanStart|ConanCenter|CRAN|crates\.io|Debian|Docker Hardened Images|Echo|FreeBSD|GHC|GitHub Actions|Go|Hackage|Hex|Homebrew|Julia|Kubernetes|Linux|Mageia|Maven|MinimOS|npm|NuGet|opam|openEuler|openSUSE|OSS-Fuzz|Packagist|Photon OS|Pub|PyPI|Red Hat|Red Hat Lightwell|Rocky Linux|Root|RubyGems|SUSE|SwiftURL|TuxCare|Ubuntu|vcpkg|VSCode|Wolfi|WordPress|GIT)(:.+)?$

events.title: events must contain an introduced object and may contain fixed, last_affected or limit objects

allOf.title: GIT ranges must use full-length commit hashes
last_affected and fixed events are mutually exclusive

bcp-05-x-01.title: GCVE BCP-05-X-01
bcp-05-x-01.description: Vulniverse JSON Schema derived from GCVE BCP-05-X-01 v1.2.

bcp-05-x-02.title: GCVE BCP-05-X-02
bcp-05-x-02.description: Vulniverse JSON Schema derived from GCVE BCP-05-X-02 v1.0.

bcp-05-x-03.title: GCVE BCP-05-X-03 Vulnerability Handling and Disclosure Timeline
bcp-05-x-03.description: Extension for representing vulnerability handling, coordination, remediation, disclosure, and regulatory notification timelines.

entities.title: Entities
entities.description: Entities participating in or referenced by timeline events.

id.title: Entity ID
id.description: Identifier unique within this x_timeline object.

category.title: Category
category.description: General category of the entity. Suggested values include adversary, coordinator, discoverer, multiplier, other, public, reporting_authority, user, and vendor.

description.title: Description
description.description: Additional non-sensitive information about the entity.

references.title: References
references.description: Public references identifying or describing the entity.

events.title: Handling and Disclosure Events
events.description: Chronological vulnerability handling and disclosure events.

type.title: Event Type
type.description: Type of vulnerability lifecycle event. Additional event types may be introduced in future revisions.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: ISO 8601 full date or RFC 3339 date-time at which the event occurred.

actor.title: Actor
actor.description: General role primarily responsible for or associated with the event. This is the legacy lightweight actor representation.

actorRefs.title: Actor References
actorRefs.description: References to entities that performed or initiated the event. Values must reference entities[].id.

recipientRefs.title: Recipient References
recipientRefs.description: References to entities that received or were directly targeted by the event. Values must reference entities[].id.

referencedEvents.title: Referenced Events
referencedEvents.description: IDs of earlier or otherwise related events in the same timeline.

references.title: References
references.description: Public references providing supporting information about the event.

regulatory.title: Regulatory Timeline
regulatory.description: Regulatory assessments and notification timelines associated with the vulnerability.

assessment.title: Assessment
assessment.description: Publisher's current assessment of whether the reporting framework applies.

trigger.title: Trigger
trigger.description: Event or condition potentially triggering the reporting requirement.

awarenessAt.title: Awareness At
awarenessAt.description: Time at which the relevant organization became aware of the condition triggering the obligation.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Notifications, reports, or other regulatory milestones.

type.title: Notification Type
type.description: Type of notification or regulatory milestone.

triggerEvent.title: Trigger Event
triggerEvent.description: ID of an event that starts or materially affects the relevant deadline.

dueAt.title: Due At
dueAt.description: Applicable deadline calculated by the producer.

status.title: Status
status.description: Current processing state of the regulatory submission. Suggested values are pending, submitted, updated, not-required, and withdrawn.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: Non-sensitive identifier or reference for the submission.

basis.title: Basis
basis.description: Human-readable reference to the provision establishing the requirement.

$comment: Deliberately permissive, like overlays/gcve-bcp-05-1.7.json. patch2vuln puts the GCVE-BCP-05 x_gcve list into OSV's free-form database_specific; this only declares it there so the editor has a control to bind the GCVE extension editor to. Real strictness comes from the vendored GCVE schema through the gcve-bcp-05 semantic validator.
